definitions.explanation: A status marking that a payment has already been received or a deposit made. Common in online shopping, invoicing, and accounting to flag an order or account as settled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}みです。
examples.english: The order has already been paid for.

examples.japanese: {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{お客様|きゃくさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Customers who have already paid will receive a confirmation email.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{発送|はっそう}される→発送する：21737_hassousuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: Since payment for this product has been received, it is scheduled to ship tomorrow.

notes:
Combines ⟦{入金|にゅうきん}→入金：05467_nyuukin⟧ (deposit of money) with ⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧ (completed), marking that a payment has already been received. Often used attributively as {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧: an order that has been paid
- {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become marked as paid
- {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}み⟦マーク→マーク：09478_maaku⟧: a paid mark or stamp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支払|しはら}い{済|ず}み→支払い済み：30038_shiharaizumi⟧: payment completed — seen from the payer's side
- {未入金|みにゅうきん}: payment not yet received — the opposite status
